not_verified.comment: Fixture identity was transcribed from the OLBG event page but NO official competition source was retrieved and confirmed in this pass. Left unverified rather than assumed. From 2026-10-21 a row also has to clear a source-tier test: only a competition's own site (or one of the two clubs' own sites) counts as verified, and a third-party listing is published as 'corroborated' instead.
not_verified.reason: OLBG does not state the tournament for these events, and pulling every official league/Tour fixture list was beyond what could be verified in this session. They are published with blank competition + verification status 'unverified'.

IHO-01.reason: The only page retrieved for this fixture was a betting-preview site (tipsterio.de), not the competition or a club. The official ICEHL schedule page (ice.hockey/saison/spielplan) renders its fixture list client-side and returned no fixture text, and the club site hcpustertal.com carried no fixture widget. Under this project's rule - a row is verified only when the fixture appears on an official page - the row is downgraded to unverified and its confidence grade falls from HIGH to MEDIUM.

reverified.result: All 13 remaining high-confidence predictions re-checked line by line; 8 corrected, 1 fixture downgraded.

source_tiers.policy: A row counts as officially verified only when the specific fixture appears on the competition's own site (governing body, league or tour) or on one of the two clubs' own sites. Reputable third parties (ESPN/ESPNcricinfo, Sofascore, AS, TNT Sports, ORF, snooker.org, Eliteprospects, tipsterio) are kept as corroboration only and are labelled 'corroborated', never 'verified'. Where a row had only a third-party source we recorded it, tried to replace it with an official one in this pass, and left the tier honest when we could not.
